items.title: DWG Parsing Out-of-Bounds Write in Autodesk AutoCAD
items.summary: A maliciously crafted DWG file, when parsed through Autodesk AutoCAD or processed by the installed DWG thumbnail handler, can force an Out-of-Bounds Write vulnerability resulting in heap corruption. A malicious actor can leverage this vulnerability to cause a crash or execute arbitrary code in the context of the current process.

items.title: DWG RLE Bitmap Integer Overflow in Autodesk AutoCAD
items.summary: A maliciously crafted DWG file, when parsed by Autodesk AutoCAD, can trigger an Integer Overflow vulnerability in RLE bitmap decompression, resulting in an undersized heap allocation and subsequent heap buffer overflow. A malicious actor can leverage this vulnerability to cause a crash or potentially execute arbitrary code in the context of the current process.
